About.title: I'm Cristóbal, but everyone calls me
About.paragraph1: Backend developer focused on databases and robust systems. I've spent over a year and a half building enterprise systems that handle millions of records without breaking a sweat, at a startup where if something breaks, I'm the one who fixes it.
About.paragraph2: I specialize in making complex systems work under real pressure: pages responding in under 2 seconds, multi-database architectures, building APIs across countries, and that legacy code no one wants to touch. I have a habit of leaving code better than I found it.
About.paragraph3: Currently building microservices in Go, consolidating best practices in PHP day to day, and getting deeper into concurrency and distributed systems: getting the pieces to talk to each other without breaking.

kudos.description: Building an ERP from the inside at a startup where 'it doesn't work' isn't an option. Development of critical modules with PHP and JavaScript, handling relational databases under real pressure, and version control with Git in a team. The guy who also touches the frontend when needed.
achievements: Designed SQL queries that efficiently process over 1,000,000 records through indexing and optimized joins
Developed PHP backend architecture with consistent response times under 2 seconds
Contributed to the development of a distributed transaction coordinator that syncs 5+ databases with atomic rollback
Co-developed a REST API with JWT authentication for real-time electronic invoicing sync between Chile and Spain (SII integration)
Part of the team that built a complete accounting module with all business rules
Implemented a bank reconciliation system with automatic/manual matching (N:M relationships) and configurable import per bank
Participated in migrating modules from PHP 5.6 to PHP 8.x, introducing reusable classes and functions
Integration with Transbank for payment processing

unab.description: Going deeper into software architecture, algorithms, and theory that lets me understand how to build more solid and scalable systems. The long journey, but with a clear destination.

marcelaPaz.description: First real work experience: systems for a school with Java and Spring Boot connected to PostgreSQL. I learned that student data cannot explode and that teachers don't tolerate bugs on Fridays.
achievements: Implemented Google API integrations that automate data synchronization for 200+ users, eliminating manual entry
Built a strategic planning system with Java and Spring Boot
Contributed to RESTful API design and database modeling with PostgreSQL
